description: Generate images through a local Huajing (AI Image Studio) server. Use when the user asks to create or generate an image, polish an image prompt, or look up previously generated images. Supports text-to-image with polling, batch count, size, negative prompt, and provider/model selection. Requires the local Huajing server (default http://127.0.0.1:4173) and Node 18+.
